reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduledAmount and reuses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules instead of re-deriving the 7.5% tolerance.

duplication.why: The worst-case approximate rule is written once inside getScheduledAmount; call sites only pass their own op.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the existing worst-case amount logic already sits, and the tolerance stays in shared/rules.

scope.why: Changes are limited to getScheduledAmount, its planning/display call sites and tests; the form-conversion calls in useScheduleEdit are correctly left at the default.

maintainability.why: Clean central rule, but inserting op before the existing positional inverse boolean (and typing it as a bare string) makes the signature easier to misuse.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every planning path goes through getScheduledAmount; the tolerance comes from getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is copied or reshaped; the existing threshold helper is called.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts decides the approximate worst case; all expected-amount paths (preview, forecast, schedule template, api model, post transaction, updateActions, UI lists/balance) call it with their op.
